scope: Boolean-only experiment, not complete Huak integration or rendering

corpus.reason: Overlapping independent nonzero regions and self-intersection contracts are not silently relabeled as native evenodd support. All timed operands use exactly the same EO inputs for every engine.

precision.lib2geom: PathIntersectionGraph precision=tolerance*0.25 in raw coordinates; common-normalized precision divided by common scale
precision.meaning: An API precision parameter, not an asserted Hausdorff error bound

method.timeout: Every lib2geom correctness case was a separate process with 15s timeout. No crash or timeout observed.
method.timing: Four selected shared EO cases: each independent bounded process executes six rotating backends over six trials, 200 calls per trial. Reported median averages the middle pair. Per-trial raw timings not retained.
method.ownership: N-1 replacement frees are inside each loop; the final result is freed after the timer.
method.representations: Clipper returns native Huak Path; candidates return C element buffers, with no final Huak Path reconstruction. Skia EO comparison uses normalized without AsWinding. All normalization/conversion is timed.
method.coverage: 31x29 grid, reference cubic sampled at64 subdivisions, near-boundary samples excluded, plus explicit probes. Bounded check, not proof of equality. Quad/conic outputs were not exercised.

notes: Historical target probe status3 merges invalid graph and upstream exceptions; the versioned source separates these as5 and6 without changing the Boolean call. Historical statuses are not retroactively recategorized.
Normalized same-oriented coincidence difference returned8cubic elements with sampled EO-empty coverage; this is not canonical-empty-buffer evidence.
Normalized reverse-coincident difference returned4cubics with584/899 mismatches and1/1 special-probe mismatch; expected empty.
Raw and normalized lib2geom results are retained separately; normalization rescues tiny-scale case in this corpus.

memory.method: Separate /usr/bin/time -l invocations of the same final stripped all-library executable, 200 Boolean calls/engine, one trial, no reference validation or JSON export. Empty startup baseline selects no cases.
memory.meaning: Whole-process high water, not allocator peak; includes common executable and startup. Baseline subtraction does not establish per-algorithm allocation.

conclusion_scope: Measurements compare only these tested candidates. No final production backend decision is established.
